notes: Passenger projection now replaces the previous app; Cluster and Passenger can each show one app. The screen startup choice is shared across Home, Screens and Wallpapers. Wallpapers is available on the main navigation bar.
changes: The required update prompt appears in every main-screen DriveCanvas section. Its Update button downloads and verifies the signed APK in place, then opens Android's installer.
fixes: Reduces duplicate Passenger tasks and stale Cluster capture sessions. Preserves background navigation apps used by the HUD. Startup services respect one saved content choice per screen.
